body: Sulphurs are tapering off but evening spinners still bring a few big browns up in the weir pool. Midge pupa under a small dry has been the dependable midday rig. Low water mornings — check the TVA schedule before you drive up.
Float windows are short with the summer generation schedule but the Sulphur/Cahill stretch below Wilbur is fishing well on slow evenings. Terrestrial action building along the grass banks.

Generation has been steady afternoons; fish the morning low-water window. Scuds and sowbugs around the upstream ramps, small midges mid-river. Bring a headlamp — the put-and-take crowd thins after dusk.
